text: Introduction to ArtAnalyze the essence, function and development laws of art, covering aesthetic theories, art schools (such as classicism and modernism) and cross-cultural art comparisons.Case: Analyze the evolution of artistic concepts in different eras by combining Leonardo Da Vinci's Mona Lisa and Picasso's Guernica.History of Chinese and Foreign ArtChina Section: From Neolithic painted pottery to Ming and Qing literati paintings, with a focus on explaining the "Northern and Southern School Theory" of landscape painting and the system of the imperial painting academy, etc.Western section: Ancient Greek sculptures, the Three Masters of the Renaissance, Impressionist light and shadow techniques, contemporary installation art, etc., supplemented by the appreciation of museum collections.Aesthetic principleExplore aesthetic experience and standards of art criticism, such as Kant's "non-utilitarian aesthetics" and Hegel's "Beauty is the sensible manifestation of ideas" and other theories.
